recipe.visualDefinition: A 1970s-style album cover featuring a group portrait of five individuals in a theatrical, dimly lit setting. The composition is split into a large square photographic area at the bottom and a clean white header at the top containing bold, vibrant typography. The subjects are dressed in period-specific attire including afros, pinstripe suits, and patterned tops, arranged around a table with candles and glassware.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast white header against a dark, moody photographic base
Vibrant orange-red display type anchoring the top-left corner
Triangular arrangement of subjects creating depth within the square frame
Repetition of circular forms in afros, glassware, and letterforms
coreInvariants: Square aspect ratio for the main image area
Tight letter spacing in the display title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The group occupies the bottom 75% of the frame, with two figures in the foreground and three in the mid-ground against a dark backdrop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold orange-red title in the top left serves as the primary entry point for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left title, moves down through the list of tracks, then circles through the group portrait starting with the foreground figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the top header provides breathing room for the dense, dark photograph below.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and browns in the photographic background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white header background for maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-red for the primary title; pops of blue and yellow in the clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements (text) contrasted with the desaturated, earthy tones of the vintage film photography.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with a circular bowl and no tail
Lowercase 't' with a short, flat crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric display paired with a lighter, more legible humanist sans for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Vertical pipe separators between text items
Right-aligned vertical metadata text on the far right edge

preserve: Tight kerning of the main title
avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric circularity and tight spacing of the era.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photograph of a 1970s soul group (3 men, 2 women) with afros and vintage suits, sitting at a candlelit table in a dark room. Use a grainy, warm-toned film aesthetic. Leave the top 25% of the canvas as a solid white horizontal bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the white bar, add a large two-line title in the top left using a bold orange-red geometric sans-serif font with tight kerning. Below it, add two lines of smaller dark grey text separated by vertical bars.

verificationChecks: Is the title text touching or nearly touching?
Is the top header pure white?
Does the photograph have a visible film grain?
Is the color palette dominated by orange, white, and dark earth tones?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Specific color of the display text
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or song titles
Specific facial features of the original subjects

avoid: Modern sans-serif fonts like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is overlapping the photographic area.
Check that the orange color is vibrant and not muddy.
Verify the 'vintage' feel of the clothing and hairstyles.
Confirm the vertical pipe separators are used in the subtitle text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast white typographic header with a square, moody, period-accurate ensemble photograph to evoke classic soul and R&B album aesthetics.
